Fox Mulder

Assistant Director Maslin

Fox Mulder

Fox Mulder

Assistant Director 2

Assistant Director Maslin

Let us remind you that the FBI is not a school for science, nor for the grinding of personal axes. Hopefully, you will be able to present us with some material evidence... To support a continued investigation.

Fox Mulder

Agent Scully, who was assigned to the X-Files... As a scientist, was stung by one of these bees and was infected with this virus. She is here today with hard and incontrovertible evidence, scientific proof that the virus she was infected with... Is, in fact, extraterrestrial. Next time I'll wear a clown suit and do balloon tricks.

Dana Scully

I was hoping it wouldn't come up.

Fox Mulder

Yes, there is a scientific basis for what happened to me. I was exposed to a virus. But as it turns out, Mulder, that virus... Is not what you thought. I can't identify it.
